text: Every couple has that one conversation. The one that went sideways, and neither of you is quite sure where.
That is where Samvaad starts. Paste the chat, or upload the recording. Hinglish, Hindi, English, it reads all of them.
And then it does the thing I did not expect. It plays the moment back to you, in your own words, acted out. You see it from the outside for the first time.
It is specific, too. Not just, you were harsh. It shows the exact line that turned it, and a kinder one you could actually say next time.
If it got heated, it stops and breathes with you before anything else. Settle first, talk second.
One conversation, a few minutes, and you understand it differently. Shall we look at yours?
